newsitem.title: SPAIN: Bank of Spain to keep rates steady-Reuter poll.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Spain to keep rates steady-Reuter poll.

text.p: The Bank of Spain is expected to keep its official rate steady at six percent on Thursday, following a 25-basis-point cut at its last regular repo tender on January 16, according to a Reuter poll of 10 analysts.
Although the analysts all expect further rate reductions this year, they say the central bank will wait at least until it has seen consumer price data for January before reducing rates again.
The Bank of Italy's decision to lower rates on Tuesday should not prompt any quick Spanish moves.
They also said the central bank was likely comfortable at the moment with the peseta level, which was not following the dollar's latest push higher against the mark.
The Bank of Spain's key money market rate has declined steadily since December 1995 from a peak of nine percent.
